name: PivotCaches
description: Represents the collection of memory caches from the PivotTable reports in a workbook.
remarks: Each memory cache is represented by a PivotCache object.
example:
For Each pc In ActiveWorkbook.PivotCaches
 pc.RefreshOnFileOpen = True
Next

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.

methods.name: Create
methods.signature: Create(SourceType As XlPivotTableSourceType, [SourceData As Variant], [Version As Variant]) As PivotCache

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description: _SourceType_ can be one of these XlPivotTableSourceType constants: xlConsolidation, xlDatabase, or xlExternal.

parameters.name: SourceData
parameters.description: The data for the new PivotTable cache.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Version of the PivotTable. _Version_ can be one of the XlPivotTableVersionList constants.
